title: Investigation of Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW)Weld Integrity on a Low- Carbon Steel Pipeline using Destructive Mechanical Testing Technique
authors: A. E. Dele
abstract: Welding is a major application in industries particularly for engineering, and is a typical process that involves joining two or more metals, either similar or dissimilar, through heat energy. Pipeline welded joint failed due to lack of weld integrity. This research aims to investigate weld integrity using destructive techniques by evaluating mechanical properties of shielded metal arc welding (SMAW) weld on low-carbon steel pipeline. Welded joint integrity was evaluated through destructive tests such as, hardness tests, impact-charpy test, tensile testing, bend test, mic & macro hardness. The average Hardness of the WM at 12 o'clock is 211.1 HV, HAZ is 208.6 HV, and BM is 208.6 HV, and at 6 o'clock, the WM is 199.0 HV, HAZ is 216.8 HV, and BM is 178.9 HV, respectively. Tensile tests of welded sample 1 and sample 2 were evaluated and the UTS (N/mm2 ) are 569.26 and 566.52, Yield stress (N/mm2 ) are 468.43 and 456.1, and breaking stress (N/mm2 ) are 380.12 and 382.4, respectively. Impact charpy test were performed on WM, HAZ and BM. The WM has average of 132.9 joules, HAZ with average of 237.1 joules and the BM average of 247.4, characteristically shows the highest value of toughness due to unchanged by welding process. Macro hardness was carried out; the weld penetration was adequate, with a penetration depth of approximately 5.8mm, weld reinforcement approximately 3mm and width approximately 2mm. The bend test showed that the samples could withstand bending without cracking or breaking. This research shows that SMAW can produce a good quality weld on a low-carbon steel pipeline with reasonable mechanical properties.
venue: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF ENGINEERING AND MODERN TECHNOLOGY

infographic.key_insight: SMAW produced an acceptable low-carbon steel pipeline weld with adequate penetration and no cracking in bend tests, indicating generally good weld integrity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results support SMAW as a viable repair or fabrication method for low-carbon steel pipelines when mechanical performance and joint quality are verified.
method: Destructive testing of the welded joint: hardness, tensile, impact-Charpy, and bend tests.
Macro/micro hardness and macro inspection to assess weld metal, HAZ, and base metal behavior.
Measured weld geometry and penetration depth to confirm fusion quality.
infographic.evidence_signal: The weld showed UTS values of 569.26 and 566.52 N/mm², Charpy impact averages of 132.9 J (WM), 237.1 J (HAZ), and 247.4 J (BM), and adequate penetration of about 5.8 mm.
infographic.watch_item: Results come from a limited set of samples, so field application should still account for variability in welding conditions and service loading.
infographic.paper_title: Investigation of Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW)Weld Integrity on a Low- Carbon Steel Pipeline using Destructive Mechanical Testing Technique

zh-Hans.title: 采用破坏性力学测试技术对低碳钢管道屏蔽金属电弧焊（SMAW）焊接完整性的研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 焊接是工业中一项重要应用，尤其在工程领域，通常通过热能将两种或多种金属（可相同或不同）连接起来。由于焊缝完整性不足，管道焊接接头发生失效。本研究旨在通过评估低碳钢管道上屏蔽金属电弧焊（SMAW）焊缝的力学性能，采用破坏性方法研究焊缝完整性。通过硬度试验、夏比冲击试验、拉伸试验、弯曲试验以及显微和宏观硬度测试等破坏性试验评价焊接接头完整性。12点方向处焊缝金属（WM）的平均硬度为211.1 HV，热影响区（HAZ）为208.6 HV，母材（BM）为208.6 HV；6点方向处，WM为199.0 HV，HAZ为216.8 HV，BM为178.9 HV。对焊接试样1和试样2进行了拉伸试验，极限抗拉强度（UTS，N/mm2）分别为569.26和566.52，屈服应力（N/mm2）分别为468.43和456.1，断裂应力（N/mm2）分别为380.12和382.4。对WM、HAZ和BM进行了夏比冲击试验。WM的平均冲击功为132.9 J，HAZ的平均冲击功为237.1 J，BM的平均冲击功为247.4 J；由于未受焊接过程影响，BM在韧性方面表现出最高值。还进行了宏观硬度测试；焊缝熔深足够，熔深约为5.8 mm，焊缝加强高约为3 mm，宽度约为2 mm。弯曲试验表明，试样能够承受弯曲而不开裂或断裂。本研究表明，SMAW能够在低碳钢管道上形成质量良好的焊缝，并具有合理的力学性能。

infographic.key_insight: SMAW形成了可接受的低碳钢管道焊缝，具有足够的熔深，且弯曲试验中未出现开裂，表明整体焊接完整性良好。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果支持SMAW作为低碳钢管道修复或制造的可行方法，前提是对力学性能和接头质量进行验证。
method: 对焊接接头进行破坏性测试：硬度、拉伸、夏比冲击和弯曲试验。
通过宏观/微观硬度测试和宏观检验评估焊缝金属、热影响区和母材的行为。
测量焊缝几何尺寸和熔深，以确认熔合质量。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该焊缝的UTS分别为569.26和566.52 N/mm²，夏比冲击平均值分别为132.9 J（WM）、237.1 J（HAZ）和247.4 J（BM），且熔深约为5.8 mm，表明焊接质量较好。
infographic.watch_item: 结果来自有限数量的样本，因此现场应用仍应考虑焊接条件和服役载荷的变化性。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A combined CEL simulation and ANN model can accurately predict and optimize friction stir welding quality in HDPE by linking process settings to temperature, axial force, and defect formation.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study gives practical welding guidelines for robust thermoplastic joints, showing that bottom preheating and tuned speed settings can reduce defects and stabilize force and thermal fields.
method: 3D coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE friction stir welding
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental temperature and axial-force data
Validation against experiments and process-map generation for defect-free windows
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved R2 values between 0.91 and 0.99, and the CEL model matched experimental void formation and thermal-mechanical responses well.
infographic.watch_item: The model is calibrated to the tested HDPE parameter range, so predictions outside the validated rotational speed, welding speed, and preheating conditions may be unreliable.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种有效的热塑性材料连接技术。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，并通过实验结果验证，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特性进行了系统研究，以实现预测。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于在不同工艺参数下模拟HDPE焊接过程，包括转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件。该CEL数值模型通过实验数据进行了验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C预热时，最大压入力从接近1600 N降至约1100 N，峰值温度则从70 °C（无预热）升至约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时间响应，其R2介于0.91到0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高精度和较强泛化能力。计算CEL仿真准确预测了焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；然而，CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，突出显示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min、并施加60 °C预热时获得最佳条件，而在无预热条件下1000 rpm时由于形成虫孔而表现出较差的可焊性。这些发现为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了工艺驱动的设计指南，并表明将计算建模与机器学习相结合能够实现高效优化，进而为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特性提供有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合CEL仿真和ANN模型，可通过将工艺设置与温度、轴向力和缺陷形成联系起来，准确预测并优化HDPE搅拌摩擦焊质量。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为稳健的热塑性接头提供了实用焊接指南，表明底部预热和优化的速度设置可以减少缺陷并稳定力场与热场。
method: HDPE搅拌摩擦焊的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验温度和轴向力数据训练的两个多层感知器ANN
通过实验验证并生成用于无缺陷窗口的工艺图
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型的R2值介于0.91到0.99之间，且CEL模型与实验中的孔洞形成以及热-机械响应吻合良好。
infographic.watch_item: 该模型仅针对所测试的HDPE参数范围进行了校准，因此在验证过的转速、焊接速度和预热条件之外的预测可能不可靠。

title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs
authors: Xinyu Chen, YuChao Chen, Yan Ren, Guangming Lv, Meng Zhang, Wang Yuan
abstract: Abstract Accurate counting and morphological analysis of welding electrodes and wire stubs are essential for warehouse data management in welding factories. However, the visual recognition of welding material stubs in real-world industrial applications is frequently hindered by issues such as missed detections, false detections, and imprecise boundary localization. To address these metrological and visual perception challenges, this paper proposes a novel High-resolution Topology-Preserving Instance Segmentation Network (HTP-Net). The proposed end-to-end architecture seamlessly integrates three core designs to realize precise decoupling and robust counting of dense targets.Specifically, a Wavelet-Driven Edge-Preserving (WEP) module is designed to retain subtle physical boundaries without loss during feature downsampling. Concurrently, a Long-Range Topology Representation Block (LTR-Block) mitigates topological disconnections resulting from extreme target slenderness by global context modeling. Finally, an Orientation-Driven Instance Segmentation Head (ODI-Seg) leverages rotational geometric priors to fundamentally resolve excessive NMS and overlapping mask artifacts. Notably, across both our custom and public datasets of dense slender materials, HTP-Net achieves substantial performance gains over existing methods, improving mAP 50 scores by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%. Furthermore, we developed an intelligent counting system for welding materials powered by the proposed model, which has been deployed and validated in a real-world factory environment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the integrated system achieves average recognition accuracies of 99% and 94% for electrode and wire stubs, respectively.

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net improves counting and boundary precision for dense welding stubs by combining high-resolution edge preservation, global topology modeling, and orientation-aware instance segmentation.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The method directly supports industrial warehouse metrology and automated inventory management for welding consumables in real factory settings.
method: Wavelet-Driven Edge-Preserving module retains subtle boundaries during downsampling
Long-Range Topology Representation Block uses global context to reduce breaks in slender object masks
Orientation-Driven Instance Segmentation Head exploits rotation priors to suppress overlap and NMS errors
infographic.evidence_signal: On custom and public dense-slender-target datasets, the model improved mAP@50 by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%, and the deployed factory system reported 99% accuracy for electrodes and 94% for wire stubs.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is strong, but deployment may still depend on stable imaging conditions and careful calibration for highly occluded or visually degraded stubs.
infographic.paper_title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs

zh-Hans.title: 用于基于视觉的密集焊接材料残端测量系统的高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 准确计数和形态分析焊接电极和焊丝残端对于焊接工厂的仓储数据管理至关重要。然而，在现实工业应用中，焊接材料残端的视觉识别常常受到漏检、误检以及边界定位不精确等问题的阻碍。为应对这些计量与视觉感知挑战，本文提出一种新的高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络（HTP-Net）。所提出的端到端架构无缝集成了三项核心设计，以实现对密集目标的精确解耦和鲁棒计数。具体而言，设计了一个小波驱动的边缘保持（WEP）模块，以在特征下采样过程中无损保留细微的物理边界。同时，长程拓扑表示块（LTR-Block）通过全局上下文建模，缓解由目标极端细长所导致的拓扑断裂。最后，方向驱动的实例分割头（ODI-Seg）利用旋转几何先验，从根本上解决过度NMS和重叠掩码伪影问题。值得注意的是，在我们自建和公开的密集细长材料数据集上，HTP-Net 相较于现有方法取得了显著性能提升，mAP 50 分数至少提高 1.2%，最高提高 55.3%。此外，我们基于所提模型开发了一个用于焊接材料的智能计数系统，并已在真实工厂环境中部署和验证。大量实验表明，该集成系统对电极和焊丝残端的平均识别准确率分别达到 99% 和 94%。

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net 通过结合高分辨率边缘保持、全局拓扑建模和面向方向的实例分割，提高了密集焊接残端的计数能力和边界精度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法可直接支持工业仓储计量以及焊接耗材在真实工厂环境中的自动化库存管理。
method: 小波驱动的边缘保持模块在下采样过程中保留细微边界
长程拓扑表示块利用全局上下文减少细长目标掩码中的断裂
方向驱动的实例分割头利用旋转先验抑制重叠和NMS误差
infographic.evidence_signal: 在自建和公开的密集细长目标数据集上，该模型将 mAP@50 至少提高了 1.2%，最高提高 55.3%；部署到工厂的系统对电极的识别准确率为 99%，对焊丝残端为 94%。
infographic.watch_item: 该方法性能表现突出，但在高度遮挡或视觉退化的残端场景中，部署效果仍可能依赖于稳定的成像条件和细致的标定。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: For D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr on DSS 2205, a longer spray distance of 190 mm produced the densest coating and the best acid corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance is a practical lever for improving coating integrity and extending the life of stainless steel components in aggressive acidic service.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm stand-off distances.
Assessed coating structure with SEM and porosity measurements.
Evaluated corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
infographic.evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, and the 190 mm coating showed the lowest corrosion rate at 0.113 mmpy versus 2.60 mmpy for the uncoated substrate.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum distance was established for one coating system and one acid environment, so transfer to other substrates, gases, or service conditions should be validated experimentally.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: 喷涂距离对酸性环境中D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层在DSS 2205上的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷硬度与金属性韧性的结合，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐蚀性。爆炸喷涂枪（D-gun）喷涂是最有前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量陶瓷涂层。Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr 涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀性能而具有应用价值。采用 1 M H₂SO₄ 这一标准化实验室电解质，在严苛酸性条件下评估了 D-gun 喷涂 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的有效性，用于考察与工业酸性环境相关的耐蚀性，并重点分析喷涂距离等关键工艺变量；喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定具有关键影响。为研究 Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr 在酸性条件下的行为，采用三种喷涂距离在双相不锈钢（DSS）2205 上喷涂 Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr，分别为 170 mm、180 mm 和 190 mm。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下对 1 M H 2 SO 4 溶液中涂层的电化学活性进行了评估。SEM 下的表面形貌研究表明，涂层呈致密层状结构，孔隙率随喷涂距离从 170 mm 时的 2.84% 降低到 190 mm 时的 1.38%，表明颗粒熔化程度和涂层致密性得到改善。190 mm 制备的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），相比未涂层基体（2.60 mmpy）更优。所有涂层试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm 是在 DSS 2205 上制备高完整性 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在严苛酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供增强的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化 D-gun 喷涂距离会显著影响 DSS 2205 上 Cr₃C₂–25NiCr 涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。建立的工艺—微观结构—性能关系为优化 D-gun 涂层参数、提高严苛酸性环境中的耐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 对于在 DSS 2205 上 D-gun 喷涂的 Cr3C2–NiCr，较长的 190 mm 喷涂距离形成了最致密的涂层，并表现出最佳的酸腐蚀耐受性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂距离是改善涂层完整性并延长不锈钢部件在严苛酸性服役条件下寿命的实用手段。
method: 在 DSS 2205 上以 170、180 和 190 mm 的喷涂距离进行 D-gun 喷涂 Cr3C2–NiCr。
采用 SEM 和孔隙率测量评估涂层结构。
使用 OCP、EIS 和动电位极化在 1 M H2SO4 中评价腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率从 170 mm 时的 2.84% 降低到 190 mm 时的 1.38%，且 190 mm 涂层的腐蚀速率最低，为 0.113 mmpy，而未涂层基体为 2.60 mmpy。

title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis
authors: Hendrik Schulz, M. Stender
abstract: Abstract Resistance spot welding is a primary joining technique in the automotive and general metal manufacturing industries due to its cost-efficiency and potential for automation. As manufacturing transitions to Industry 4.0, an unprecedented volume of high-frequency process data is recorded. Recent advances rely on machine learning to correlate process data with weld quality. However, existing correlational models are typically trained under restricted laboratory conditions, lacking both physical interpretability and generalization across heterogeneous stack-up configurations with varying materials, coatings, thicknesses, and electrode guns. Here we show that by applying a two-phase causal discovery framework and time series clustering to 15,096 representative profiles derived from over 1.8 million welds, one can extract the structural dependencies of signal morphology from multicollinear stack-up configurations. Increased alloying content is associated with accelerated localized heating, advancing dynamic resistance peaks and suppressing secondary peaks in press-hardened steel. Sheet thickness proportionally scales dynamic resistance, displacement, and force amplitudes, while serving as a primary indicator for post-expansion stability. Reducing tip face diameter from 8 to 6 mm increases the initial resistance peak by 9 % and alters post-expansion mechanics. Finally, at a constant thickness, internal faying surface quantity remains statistically insignificant to macroscopic resistance.

infographic.key_insight: A two-phase causal discovery and clustering workflow revealed how welding stack-up factors drive resistance-weld signal morphology beyond simple correlations.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The findings can help engineers interpret high-frequency spot-welding data, improve process setup across varying materials and geometries, and support more transferable quality monitoring.
method: Causal discovery on high-dimensional time-series process signals
Time series clustering to group representative weld profiles
Analysis across heterogeneous stack-ups with different materials, coatings, thicknesses, and electrode guns
infographic.evidence_signal: The study analyzed 15,096 representative profiles extracted from more than 1.8 million welds and linked stack-up variables to measurable changes in resistance, displacement, force, and peak timing.
infographic.watch_item: Because the framework is data-rich and configuration-specific, deploying it reliably in new production settings may still require careful validation on unseen stack-up combinations.
infographic.paper_title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis

zh-Hans.title: 钢材电阻点焊中信号形态驱动因素的因果发现：高维数据分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 电阻点焊由于其成本效率高且具备自动化潜力，是汽车和通用金属制造行业中的主要连接技术。随着制造业向工业4.0转型，前所未有的大量高频工艺数据被记录下来。近期进展依赖机器学习将工艺数据与焊缝质量相关联。然而，现有相关性模型通常在受限的实验室条件下训练，既缺乏物理可解释性，也难以在材料、涂层、厚度和电极枪各异的异质搭接配置之间实现泛化。本文表明，通过对来自超过180万次焊点的15,096个代表性轮廓应用两阶段因果发现框架和时间序列聚类，可以从多重共线的搭接配置中提取信号形态的结构依赖关系。合金含量增加与局部加热加速相关，表现为镀硼淬硬钢中动态电阻峰提前并抑制次峰。板材厚度会按比例放大动态电阻、位移和力的幅值，同时作为后扩张稳定性的主要指示因素。将端面直径从8 mm减小到6 mm会使初始电阻峰提高9%，并改变后扩张力学行为。最后，在厚度恒定时，内部搭接面数量对宏观电阻在统计上并不显著。

infographic.key_insight: 两阶段因果发现与聚类工作流揭示了焊接搭接因素如何驱动电阻焊信号形态，而不仅仅是简单相关。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些发现有助于工程师解释高频点焊数据，改进不同材料和几何条件下的工艺设定，并支持更具可迁移性的质量监测。
method: 高维时间序列工艺信号的因果发现
时间序列聚类以分组代表性焊点轮廓
跨异质搭接配置的分析，涉及不同材料、涂层、厚度和电极枪
infographic.evidence_signal: 该研究分析了从超过180万次焊点中提取的15,096个代表性轮廓，并将搭接变量与电阻、位移、力以及峰值时序的可测变化联系起来。
infographic.watch_item: 由于该框架数据密集且高度依赖具体配置，在新的生产环境中可靠部署时，可能仍需要对未见过的搭接组合进行仔细验证。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin can rapidly screen robotic welding settings and controller actions for in-space metal joining before expensive flight-like tests.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work helps de-risk on-orbit manufacturing by combining reduced-order thermal physics, surrogate models, and robot control to predict weld quality under constrained space-environment conditions.
method: Finite-volume weld-pool thermal model with solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and local-pressure effects.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates trained and validated with repeated five-fold cross-validation.
Simulated six-axis manipulator study with closed-loop proportional control for a UR5 L-shaped seam.
infographic.evidence_signal: Across 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fell within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals, and the GP outperformed the neural network on all eight outputs in repeated cross-validation.
infographic.watch_item: The controller and model are still simulation-based, so thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and hardware-in-the-loop testing are needed before operational deployment.
infographic.paper_title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

zh-Hans.title: 通过物理约束数字孪生降低太空金属连接中机器人焊接的风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着在轨服务、制造和装配需求的增长，可靠的金属连接在模块化建造和在轨修复中的重要性再次受到关注。机器人焊接前景良好，但在低重力和低压条件下的性能仍缺乏充分表征，且类飞行测试受限。在英国航天局支持下，ISPARK 项目正在开发一种基于物理的数字孪生，用于结构化的工艺风险降低。本文评估了一种基于模型的原型系统，该系统结合了有限体积热焊池模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及一个仿真的六轴机械臂。该降阶模型包含固-液相变、有效热毛细输运以及局部压力参数。重力单独通过静水压与毛细压之比进行评估，并不进入热能方程。基于重复的五折交叉验证，GP 对全部八个输出的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界案例中，80 个求解器响应中的 74 个落入名义 90% GP 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括缩放和预测方差计算。在一项仿真的 UR5 L 形焊缝研究中，当运动速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器会调整协同电源设定。有限体积重新评估表明，12 个闭环工作点和 12 个开环工作点中的 9 个位于示意性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根侧宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试之前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。还需要热真空、针对性的低重力以及机器人硬件在环研究来评估该模型和控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 基于物理的数字孪生可以在昂贵的类飞行测试之前，快速筛选太空金属连接的机器人焊接设定和控制动作。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究将降阶热物理、代理模型和机器人控制相结合，可在受限的太空环境条件下预测焊缝质量，从而有助于降低在轨制造风险。
method: 具有固-液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力效应的有限体积焊池热模型。
采用重复五折交叉验证训练并验证的高斯过程和神经网络代理模型。
面向 UR5 L 形焊缝、具有闭环比例控制的仿真六轴机械臂研究。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在 10 个留出的边界案例中，80 个求解器响应中的 74 个落入名义 90% GP 预测区间内；在重复交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的表现均优于神经网络。
infographic.watch_item: 控制器和模型仍基于仿真，因此在投入实际运行前，需要进行热真空、低重力和硬件在环测试。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among four spray routes for WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, HVAF and HVOF delivered the best overall wear performance, while HVAF gave the strongest corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Choosing the spray process strongly changes coating density, hardness, tribology, and corrosion behavior, so process selection is as important as material composition for wear-critical, corrosion-exposed components.
method: Prepared WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, wear rate/friction, and electrochemical corrosion performance across the four coatings.
Identified dominant wear mechanisms from wear-track morphology and particle load transfer behavior.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness increased from APS (771.4 HV) to DS (954.2 HV) to HVOF (1166.2 HV) and HVAF (1162.2 HV), while wear rate dropped from 7.93×10^-5 to 1.10×10^-5 mm3/N·m; HVAF also had the best corrosion metrics (Ecorr -0.37 VSCE, Icorr 1.75 μA/cm², Rp 20438.5 Ω).
infographic.watch_item: The results are based on a specific coating system, substrate, and test conditions, so the ranking may shift with different feedstock quality, thickness, or service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性能。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性能。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度均高于304不锈钢，其数值分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率均低于304不锈钢，分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5和(1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可见剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是该硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承担摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层。此外，HVOF和HVAF涂层具有更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）以及最大的耐腐蚀性（20438.5 Ω）。在这四种涂层中，APS涂层的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在304不锈钢上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的四种喷涂路线中，HVAF和HVOF表现出最佳的综合耐磨性能，而HVAF具有最强的耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 喷涂工艺的选择会显著改变涂层致密性、硬度、摩擦学行为和耐腐蚀行为，因此对于耐磨且暴露于腐蚀环境的部件而言，工艺选择与材料组成同等重要。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较四种涂层的微观组织、维氏硬度、磨损率/摩擦系数以及电化学腐蚀性能。
根据磨痕形貌和颗粒载荷传递行为识别主导磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 硬度从APS（771.4 HV）到DS（954.2 HV）再到HVOF（1166.2 HV）和HVAF（1162.2 HV）逐步升高，而磨损率从7.93×10^-5降至1.10×10^-5 mm3/N·m；HVAF还具有最佳的腐蚀指标（Ecorr -0.37 VSCE，Icorr 1.75 μA/cm²，Rp 20438.5 Ω）。
infographic.watch_item: 这些结果基于特定的涂层体系、基体和测试条件，因此在不同的原料质量、涂层厚度或服役环境下，性能排序可能会发生变化。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating delivered the best oxidation protection on SA516 boiler steel, cutting maximum weight gain by 95.71% versus bare steel at 900°C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For high-temperature boiler and thermal-service components, Ni-Cr ceramic composite coatings can greatly improve oxidation resistance by forming dense protective oxides and limiting spallation.
method: Compared Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings on SA516 steel.
Applied both HVOF and plasma spray deposition routes.
Evaluated cyclic oxidation for 50 cycles at 900°C using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports cyclic air oxidation data showing severe spalling in uncoated steel, while the HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating achieved the lowest weight gain and the most protective oxide scale.
infographic.watch_item: Results are from laboratory cyclic oxidation only, so long-term service performance under real boiler thermal gradients, erosion, and steam chemistry still needs validation.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel

zh-Hans.title: HVOF和等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层在SA516锅炉钢上的显微组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了采用高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术制备的Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层在SA516锅炉钢上的显微组织与高温氧化行为。在900°C的模拟实验室环境中进行了50个循环的空气循环氧化试验，并通过X射线衍射（XRD）、配有能量色散光谱（SEM/EDS）的扫描电子显微镜以及X射线元素映射分析了所得显微组织和相变。未涂层SA516钢的氧化层发生了严重剥落和开裂，形成了未受保护的相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层与裸SA516钢相比，将最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有优异的抗氧化性能。该涂层性能提升归因于形成了致密、具有保护性的氧化层，该氧化层由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成，同时伴随孔隙率降低和显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层在SA516锅炉钢上提供了最佳抗氧化保护，在900°C下相较裸钢将最大增重降低了95.71%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于高温锅炉和热服役部件，Ni-Cr陶瓷复合涂层可通过形成致密的保护性氧化物并抑制剥落，显著提高抗氧化性能。
method: 比较了SA516钢上的Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
采用了HVOF和等离子喷涂两种沉积路线。
在900°C下通过XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线映射评估了50个循环的循环氧化。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告的循环空气氧化数据表明，未涂层钢发生了严重剥落，而HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层表现出最低的增重和最具保护性的氧化膜。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅来自实验室循环氧化，因此在真实锅炉的热梯度、冲蚀和蒸汽化学环境下的长期服役性能仍需验证。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power increases penetration and keyhole size but can deflect the arc, while higher travel speed reduces heat input and higher current broadens the weld and stabilizes the arc.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide process guidance for tuning hybrid welding parameters to control molten pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability in low-CTE Invar steel fabrication.
method: Numerical simulation of molten pool fluid dynamics
High-speed photography of arc and pool behavior
Parameter study across laser power, welding speed, and current

infographic.watch_item: The findings are parameter-window specific, so direct transfer to other joint setups, thicknesses, or shielding conditions may require re-optimization.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多关注工艺方面，对熔池流体动力学行为缺乏深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了激光-TIG复合焊接Invar钢过程中不同工艺参数对熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，这为优化Invar钢焊接工艺提供了重要的理论支撑。结果表明，在激光功率5 ~ 6 kW范围内，功率增加会导致更大的反冲压力，从而促进更大的熔深和小孔尺寸，增强整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更容易受到激光吸引并发生偏转。在焊接速度0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min范围内，更高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流动速度和冷却速率增加；此外，在较高速度下电弧更容易发生变形。在焊接电流150 ~ 170 A范围内，电流增加会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，较高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，更高的激光功率会增加熔深和小孔尺寸，但可能使电弧偏转；而更高的行进速度会降低热输入，更高的电流则会增大焊缝宽度并稳定电弧。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为调节复合焊接参数以控制低热膨胀系数Invar钢制造中的熔池流动、焊缝几何形状和电弧稳定性提供了工艺指导。
method: 熔池流体动力学数值模拟
电弧和熔池行为的高速摄影
激光功率、焊接速度和电流的参数研究
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了激光功率5–6 kW、焊接速度0.5–0.8 m/min以及电流150–170 A范围内的观测趋势，并将其与熔深、焊缝宽度、流动和电弧行为的可测变化联系起来。
infographic.watch_item: 这些结论具有参数窗口特异性，因此直接迁移到其他接头形式、板厚或保护条件时可能需要重新优化。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder enables dense, layered coatings, while spray method selection controls the tradeoff between hardness and tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study identifies process routes for optimizing wear-resistant WC–Co–Cr coatings on machine parts operating under high friction and load.
method: Compared detonation spraying (DS) and HVOF for WC–Co–Cr cermet coating deposition.
Characterized powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Assessed phase/structure quality and tribological behavior, including microhardness and friction coefficient.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports average microhardness of 1449 HV for DS coatings and a low friction coefficient of Kt = 0.143 for HVOF coatings, supporting method-dependent performance differences.
infographic.watch_item: Results depend strongly on powder homogeneity and spray parameters, so performance may not transfer directly to other feedstocks or deposition settings.
infographic.paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVOF和爆轰喷涂制备WC–CO–CR涂层的结构形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆轰喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究包括对初始粉末形貌的分析，以及利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能谱分析（EDS）对涂层显微组织和相组成的研究。结果表明，采用均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末，可形成致密的层状结构，并使碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆轰喷涂可获得更高硬度的涂层（平均显微硬度1449 HV），而HVOF则可制备具有高致密度、均匀显微组织和低摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）的涂层。对比分析证实，涂层的力学和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机器零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强摩擦和高载荷条件下运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: 完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末有助于形成致密的层状涂层，而喷涂方法的选择决定了硬度与摩擦学性能之间的权衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究确定了用于优化在高摩擦和高载荷条件下运行的机器零件耐磨WC–Co–Cr涂层的工艺路线。
method: 对WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层沉积过程中的爆轰喷涂（DS）与HVOF进行了比较。
使用SEM和EDS表征粉末形貌及涂层显微组织。
评估了相/结构质量和摩擦学行为，包括显微硬度和摩擦系数。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告DS涂层的平均显微硬度为1449 HV，HVOF涂层的摩擦系数较低，为Kt = 0.143，支持了不同方法对应性能差异的结论。
infographic.watch_item: 结果在很大程度上取决于粉末均匀性和喷涂参数，因此其性能可能不能直接推广到其他供料粉末或沉积条件。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-spray settings strongly control whether self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings become denser and harder or more wear-resistant, with clear trade-offs between friction and durability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical parameter guidance for restoring and strengthening machine parts using detonation-sprayed nickel-based coatings.
method: Varied barrel filling level from 48–68% to tune coating density and defect formation.
Adjusted gas molar ratio (O/C = 1.026–1.856) and inter-shot delay (0–1 s) to influence microstructure and tribology.
Evaluated coatings using morphology, roughness, hardness, friction, and specific wear rate tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports a minimum friction coefficient of 0.674 ± 0.136 at 48% filling and O/C = 1.026, while the best wear resistance reached a specific wear rate of 0.000189 mm³/(N·m) at O/C = 1.856 with 1 s inter-shot delay.
infographic.watch_item: Optimizing for low friction can increase wear, so process settings must be balanced for the intended service condition rather than tuned to a single metric.
infographic.paper_title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 系自熔性涂层结构以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。研究参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次喷射间延迟（0–1 s）。对涂层的形貌分析表明，涂层具有典型的层状结构，并且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率会形成更致密、孔隙率更低的涂层结构，而中等和较高的填充率则促进微裂纹形成，这可能是由于残余应力增大所致。摩擦学试验表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得最小摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着更高的磨损。最高耐磨性出现在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次喷射间延迟增加至 1 s 的条件下，使比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增加两次喷射间延迟可使 Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。最高硬度可达 905.6 HV，出现在有利于形成致密结构和强化相的一组参数组合下。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数与提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。该研究结果可用于开发机器零部件修复和表面强化技术。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数强烈控制自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 涂层是变得更致密、更硬，还是更耐磨，并且摩擦与耐久性之间存在明确权衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究为采用爆炸喷涂镍基涂层修复和强化机械零件提供了实用的参数指导。
method: 将炮管填充率在 48–68% 范围内变化，以调控涂层致密性和缺陷形成。
调整气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）和两次喷射间延迟（0–1 s），以影响显微组织和摩擦学性能。
通过形貌、粗糙度、硬度、摩擦和比磨损率测试对涂层进行评价。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告在填充率 48% 且 O/C = 1.026 时，摩擦系数最低为 0.674 ± 0.136；而在 O/C = 1.856 且两次喷射间延迟为 1 s 时，最佳耐磨性对应的比磨损率达到 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。
infographic.watch_item: 若以低摩擦为目标进行优化，可能会增加磨损，因此过程参数必须根据预期服役条件进行平衡，而不能只针对单一指标进行调整。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: A multitask neural network can jointly predict UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness well, but stacking ensemble learning gives more accurate task-specific predictions overall.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This comparison helps welding engineers choose between shared-learning models for efficiency and ensemble models for highest predictive precision in process optimization and quality control.
method: Train a multitask neural network with shared hidden layers and task-specific outputs.
Train a stacking ensemble on the same welding dataset for separate outputs.
Compare both models using RMSE and R² across UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports MTNN RMSE/R² of 0.1288/0.6724 for UTS, 0.0886/0.9215 for weld hardness, and 0.1125/0.8407 for HAZ hardness, while stacking achieved 0.0263/0.9863, 0.0467/0.9782, and 0.1109/0.8453, respectively.
infographic.watch_item: Stacking performs best here, but it may require more tuning and may not generalize as efficiently as multitask learning when data are sparse or tasks are more strongly coupled.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 用于焊接应用中预测 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中单个模型被设计为同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与针对每个任务分别训练独立模型不同，MTL 在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定的差异。在本研究中，我们基于同一数据集，比较了两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，用于预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在 MTNN 中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习任务之间的共同模式，同时保持任务特定的输出。两种方法均使用 RMSE 和 R² 进行评估，以确定其预测准确性和总体有效性。结果表明，该方法具有较强的预测能力，其 RMSE 分别为 UTS 的 0.1288、焊缝硬度的 0.0886 和 HAZ 硬度的 0.1125，而 R² 值分别为 0.6724、0.9215 和 0.8407。这表明它能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的准确性方面优于 MTL：UTS 的 RMSE 为 0.0263，R² 为 0.9863；焊缝硬度的 RMSE 为 0.0467，R² 为 0.9782；HAZ 硬度的 RMSE 为 0.1109，R² 为 0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高精度、任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL 适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，可提供高效训练和良好泛化；而堆叠集成在需要高精度、相互独立预测的情况下表现更好。两种方法都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，因此适合作为进一步研究混合模型的前驱，后者可将两种方法的最佳特征结合起来。

infographic.key_insight: 多任务神经网络可以联合较好地预测 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度，但堆叠集成学习在整体上能提供更准确的任务特定预测。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这一比较有助于焊接工程师在工艺优化和质量控制中，在共享学习模型的效率与集成模型的最高预测精度之间做出选择。
method: 使用共享隐藏层和任务特定输出训练多任务神经网络。
在同一焊接数据集上训练堆叠集成模型，以获得分别输出。
使用 RMSE 和 R² 在 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度上比较两种模型。
infographic.watch_item: 在此案例中堆叠集成表现最佳，但它可能需要更多调参，并且在数据稀疏或任务耦合更强时，其泛化效率可能不如多任务学习。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings achieve better corrosion and wear performance when droplet flattening is high and porosity is low, with humidity strongly influencing tribological behavior.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray parameters to maximize disk-like splat formation and minimize pores can improve long-term protection of carbon-steel components in humid service environments.
method: Prepared Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters.
Compared coating microstructure, long-term corrosion behavior, and wear behavior across humidity conditions.
Evaluated droplet morphology, porosity, friction coefficient, and wear rate.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that coatings with higher droplet circularity/expansion formed denser fine-lamellar structures, while increasing humidity reduced friction coefficient and wear rate, and higher porosity correlated with poorer corrosion resistance.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends strongly on spray parameter control and environmental humidity, so results may not transfer directly without matching processing and service conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下Fe基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在不同喷涂参数下于Q235碳钢上成功制备了Fe基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成具有致密显微组织的细层状结构涂层至关重要。涂层中较高的孔隙缺陷发生率与较差的长期耐蚀性相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度条件的升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 当液滴铺展程度高且孔隙率低时，爆炸喷涂Fe基非晶涂层可获得更好的耐腐蚀和耐磨性能，而湿度对其摩擦学行为有显著影响。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂参数以最大化盘状飞溅片形成并最小化孔隙，可提高碳钢部件在潮湿服役环境中的长期防护性能。
method: 在不同喷涂参数下，采用爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上制备Fe基非晶涂层。
比较不同湿度条件下涂层的显微组织、长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为。
评估液滴形貌、孔隙率、摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要表明，具有更高液滴圆度/铺展因子的涂层形成了更致密的细层状结构，而湿度升高会降低摩擦系数和磨损率，且更高的孔隙率与更差的耐蚀性相关。
infographic.watch_item: 性能高度依赖喷涂参数控制和环境湿度，因此若工艺和服役条件不匹配，结果可能无法直接迁移。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Raising the flame-spraying O2/C2H2 ratio densified Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coatings, reducing porosity and roughness while improving adhesion, with peak hardness at an intermediate ratio.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Tuning the O2/C2H2 ratio offers a practical process-control lever to optimize coating quality for wear- and corrosion-resistant surface engineering on stainless steel substrates.
method: Flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coatings onto AISI 321 steel using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system.
Varied oxygen-to-acetylene ratio to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 and monitored spray conditions with Accuraspray 4.0.
Measured microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports porosity dropping from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%, roughness from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, adhesion rising from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa, and maximum microhardness of 1051.7 HV at O2/C2H2 = 1.1.
infographic.watch_item: The optimal gas ratio may depend on spray distance, feedstock state, and part geometry, so the reported trends should be validated for other setups before scale-up.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬–镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过Metal Coat 6PM-II系统采用火焰喷涂制备。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气/乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比例调整为1.0、1.1和1.2。喷涂参数使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高O₂/C₂H₂比例使涂层结构致密化，孔隙率由1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度由22.14 ± 4.3 MPa提高到35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在O₂/C₂H₂比例为1.1时获得了最高平均显微硬度1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比例为调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 提高火焰喷涂O2/C2H2比例使Ni–Cr–B–Si自熔性涂层更致密，降低孔隙率和粗糙度并提高结合强度，而最高硬度出现在中间比例。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 调节O2/C2H2比例提供了一种实用的工艺控制手段，可优化不锈钢基体上耐磨、耐腐蚀表面工程的涂层质量。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统将Ni–Cr–B–Si自熔性涂层火焰喷涂到AISI 321钢上。
将氧气/乙炔比例分别调至1.0、1.1和1.2，并用Accuraspray 4.0监测喷涂条件。
测量显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告孔隙率由1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度由4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度由22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa，并且在O2/C2H2 = 1.1时获得最大显微硬度1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳气体比例可能取决于喷涂距离、喷涂材料状态和零件几何形状，因此在放大应用前应针对其他装置验证这些趋势。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants must be designed as coupled biomechanical-biomaterial systems, where geometry, gait-phase loading, and graded Ti-HAp/FGM interfaces jointly determine fixation durability and clinical performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For implant and coating design, the main challenge is to balance load transfer and osseointegration while controlling micromotion, fatigue, corrosion, and coating integrity under realistic cyclic loading.
method: Systematic review of DWBI concepts, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation pathways.
Trend analysis of 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies.
Synthesis of finite element modeling, gait-phase loading, FGM/Ti-HAp architectures, and in-vivo evidence.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports a mixed evidence base: many studies remained at bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical validation was comparatively limited.
infographic.watch_item: A key concern is that graded Ti-HAp and FGM findings are largely supported by non-DWBI analog studies, so device-specific validation is still needed before broad clinical translation.
infographic.paper_title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

zh-Hans.title: 远端负重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端负重植入物（DWBIs）代表一类临床上新兴的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨转位康复中恢复远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、结合步态相载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度和转化准备度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究构成了较小的验证层。以HAp为中心的表面或本体材料工程占据了文献主体；然而，关于梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料及机理类比研究，支持的是机理上的可行性，而非DWBI特异性验证。从机理上看，DWBI应被理解为一个整合的生物材料-力学系统，连接宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态相载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程。其转化将要求采用更贴近患者真实情况的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析流程、器械级疲劳和涂层完整性测试、标准化的体内终点评估、协调一致的康复方案，以及由注册登记数据支持的临床随访，以将力学可行性与持久的生物固定和患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端负重植入物必须被设计为耦合的生物力学-生物材料系统，其中几何形态、步态相载荷以及梯度Ti-HAp/FGM界面共同决定固定耐久性和临床性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于植入物和涂层设计，主要挑战是在真实循环载荷条件下，在控制微动、疲劳、腐蚀和涂层完整性的同时，实现负载传递与骨整合之间的平衡。
method: 对DWBI概念、生物材料界面和临床转化路径进行系统综述。
对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行趋势分析。
综合有限元建模、步态相载荷、FGM/Ti-HAp结构以及体内证据。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要显示证据基础具有混合性：许多研究仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床验证相对有限。
infographic.watch_item: 一个关键问题是，梯度Ti-HAp和FGM的发现主要由非DWBI类比研究支持，因此在广泛临床转化之前仍需要器械特异性的验证。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with tuned DDFW settings substantially improves AA2024-T351 weld strength, while deep learning can predict tensile performance from process conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical process-optimization route for stronger lightweight aerospace and automotive aluminium joints without relying on conventional fusion welding.
method: L18 orthogonal-array experiments on AA2024-T351 DDFW
Varied friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying-surface geometry, and friction time
Compared deep learning models to predict ultimate tensile strength
infographic.evidence_signal: The best-tested setting reached 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength, and the top deep learning model achieved about R² = 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The predictive model performance is moderate rather than near-perfect, so broader validation on more datasets and joint conditions is still needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔-凸台几何结构和深度学习预测提升直驱摩擦焊中AA2024-T351的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 对轻量化、高强度材料在航空航天和汽车工业中的需求不断增长，使得AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中实现可靠接头仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化AA2024-T351直驱摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。研究引入了一种新颖的钻孔-凸台几何结构，其灵感来源于传统的榫卯接头，以增强机械咬合并提高焊缝完整性。实验采用L18正交表系统设计，以评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。实验在一台定制车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、接触面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，实施了先进的深度学习模型，包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络，用于根据焊接条件预测极限拉伸强度。结果表明，30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa镦粗压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台几何结构以及4 min摩擦时间的最优参数组合表现出优异的力学性能，拉伸强度达到538 MPa，扭转强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面对平面接头相比，钻孔-凸台结构表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，能够有效捕捉工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔-凸台接头几何结构与优化后的DDFW参数相结合，可显著提高AA2024-T351焊接强度，同时深度学习可根据工艺条件预测拉伸性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为无需依赖传统熔焊的更高强度轻量化航空航天和汽车铝合金接头提供了一条实用的工艺优化途径。
method: 针对AA2024-T351直驱摩擦焊进行L18正交表实验
改变摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、接触面几何形状和摩擦时间
比较深度学习模型以预测极限拉伸强度
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳测试条件下拉伸强度达到538 MPa、扭转强度达到325 MPa，表现最优的深度学习模型R²约为0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 该预测模型的性能属于中等水平，而非接近完美，因此在部署前仍需在更多数据集和接头条件上进行更广泛的验证。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed titanium dioxide metal-ceramic coatings can have their surface roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity tuned by adjusting spraying parameters, with optimal settings maximizing water repellency.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide process-parameter rules for designing coating recipes that improve surface functionality in thermal spray applications.
method: Varied detonation spraying parameters, including nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Measured coating surface roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity/contact angle.
Derived empirical relationships, including inverse power and parabolic laws, to predict surface behavior and identify optimal spraying conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports controlled experimental dependence of roughness, thickness, and contact angle on process conditions and the development of new predictive equations.
infographic.watch_item: The relationships appear to be empirical and may require validation across different substrates, nozzle setups, and scaling conditions before broader deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂获得的钛基涂层表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 描述了基于二氧化钛的金属陶瓷涂层表面性质随爆炸喷涂条件的变化规律。研究发现，表面粗糙度、表面厚度及其疏水性等性质可通过选择喷涂工艺过程的某些参数值在制备过程中加以控制。确定了爆炸喷涂工艺参数的最佳取值，可使所制备涂层具有最大的疏水性。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度依照反幂律随喷嘴通过速度变化。粗糙度和接触角依照抛物线规律随喷涂距离变化。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，并确定涂层喷涂的最佳工况，以保证其最佳疏水性。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂的二氧化钛金属陶瓷涂层可通过调整喷涂参数来调控表面粗糙度、厚度和疏水性，其中最佳参数设置可使其水排斥性最大化。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为热喷涂应用中的涂层配方设计提供了工艺参数规律，有助于提升涂层表面功能性。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂参数，包括喷嘴通过速度和喷涂距离。
测量涂层表面粗糙度、厚度以及疏水性/接触角。
推导经验关系式，包括反幂律和抛物线规律，用于预测表面行为并识别最佳喷涂条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了粗糙度、厚度和接触角对工艺条件的受控实验依赖关系，并提出了新的预测方程。
