title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification raised hardness in Cr3C2–NiCr coatings, but the response depended strongly on deposition route and treatment settings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-resistant thermal-sprayed coatings, UNSM can improve local mechanical performance, yet process optimization must be tailored separately for detonation-sprayed and HVOF deposits.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed and HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr coatings after UNSM.
Varied static load (20, 30 N) and vibration amplitude (20, 30 μm) across four treated samples per route.
Measured hardness with nanoindentation-like instrumental testing at 300 mN and examined post-scratch SEM morphology.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness ranged from 820–970 HV for DS samples and 546–1165 HV for HVOF samples, with the highest values at DS-T1 (20 N/20 μm) and HVOF-T4 (30 N/30 μm).
infographic.watch_item: Scratch SEM showed crack-like discontinuities, but the study does not clearly separate UNSM-induced effects from scratch damage or establish a definitive scratch-resistance ranking.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 对爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料（HVOF）沉积的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层在超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）作用下的硬度和划痕后表面形貌进行了研究。按每种沉积工艺评估了4个处理样品，静载荷分别为20和30 N，振幅分别为20和30 µm。采用300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间测量仪器硬度。DS样品的硬度值为820–970 HV，而HVOF样品的范围更宽，为546–1165 HV。最高值分别记录于20 N/20 µm条件下的DS-T1，以及30 N/30 µm条件下的HVOF-T4。划痕试验后获取的SEM视场显示，两类涂层系列均存在表面反差不均一和类裂纹不连续特征。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法区分UNSM引起的损伤，也不能建立划痕抗力的排序。可获得的平均摩擦系数作为6个处理样品的补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应具有样品依赖性，并强调需要将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合评估。

infographic.key_insight: 超声纳米晶表面改性提高了Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的硬度，但其响应强烈依赖于沉积工艺和处理参数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨热喷涂涂层，UNSM可以改善局部力学性能，但工艺优化必须分别针对爆炸喷涂和HVOF沉积层进行。
method: 比较了UNSM处理后爆炸喷涂和HVOF的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层。
在每种工艺下，对4个处理样品改变静载荷（20、30 N）和振幅（20、30 μm）。
采用类似纳米压痕的仪器测试在300 mN下测量硬度，并观察划痕后的SEM形貌。
infographic.evidence_signal: DS样品的硬度范围为820–970 HV，HVOF样品为546–1165 HV，最高值分别出现在DS-T1（20 N/20 μm）和HVOF-T4（30 N/30 μm）。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕SEM显示类裂纹不连续特征，但该研究未能清晰区分UNSM引起的效应与划痕损伤，也未建立明确的划痕抗力排序。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.
venue: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite coatings on Grade 2 titanium achieved the best tribological performance at O2/C2H2 ratios of 3.0–3.3, balancing phase composition, crystallinity, and adhesion.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These biocoatings can improve wear resistance and surface bioactivity of titanium implants, supporting longer service life and faster osseointegration in physiological environments.
method: Deposited hydroxyapatite on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium by detonation spraying.
Varied the O2/C2H2 ratio from 2.6 to 3.7 to tune coating structure and properties.
Evaluated phase composition, surface morphology, hydrophobicity, and tribological behavior in dry and Ringer’s solution.
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD showed hydroxyapatite as the dominant phase with some α-tricalcium phosphate, and tribology testing found the lowest wear volume and best friction behavior at O2/C2H2 = 3.0 and 3.3.
infographic.watch_item: Detonation spraying at high thermal/dynamic loads can induce phase changes and structural heterogeneity, so process control is critical to avoid inconsistent coating quality.
infographic.paper_title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD

zh-Hans.title: 采用爆轰喷涂法研究生物涂层摩擦学性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆轰喷涂法，在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 2.6–3.7 的不同条件下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于商用纯 2 级钛基体上。X 射线衍射分析证实羟基磷灰石相占主导，同时部分形成了 α-磷酸三钙，这归因于爆轰射流中的高温和强烈动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出明显的疏水性、高结构非均匀性以及发达的表面微观起伏，有利于增强与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨整合。在干摩擦条件和 Ringer 溶液中进行的摩擦学测试表明，与未涂覆的 2 级钛相比，涂层的耐磨性显著提高。在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 3.0 和 3.3 时制备的涂层表现出最佳摩擦特性和最低磨损体积，这与晶化度、相组成和黏附强度的最佳组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层可在生理环境中提供稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实了爆轰喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入物耐久性、生物相容性和服役可靠性方面的应用前景。

infographic.key_insight: 在 2 级钛上采用爆轰喷涂制备的羟基磷灰石涂层在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 3.0–3.3 时表现出最佳摩擦学性能，在相组成、晶化度和黏附性之间实现了平衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这类生物涂层可提高钛植入物的耐磨性和表面生物活性，有助于在生理环境中延长服役寿命并加快骨整合。
method: 采用爆轰喷涂法将羟基磷灰石沉积于商用纯 2 级钛上。
将 O₂/C₂H₂ 比从 2.6 调整至 3.7，以调控涂层结构和性能。
评估了相组成、表面形貌、疏水性以及在干摩擦和 Ringer 溶液中的摩擦学行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD 显示羟基磷灰石为主导相，并含有部分 α-磷酸三钙；摩擦学测试表明，在 O₂/C₂H₂ = 3.0 和 3.3 时，磨损体积最低且摩擦行为最佳。
infographic.watch_item: 在高热/动态载荷下进行爆轰喷涂可能引发相变和结构非均匀性，因此工艺控制对于避免涂层质量不一致至关重要。

title: Synthesis of Amorphous and Crystalline Silicon Dioxide Powder Composites from Rice Husk Ash for Thermal Spray Deposit
authors: Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov, Elzhan Birzhan, G.S. Bektasova, Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина
abstract: This paper presents the synthesis of silicon dioxide (SiO₂) from rice husk ash through chemical treatment followed by heat treatment at 800 °C for 3 h. The structural and physicochemical properties of the synthesized silica were investigated using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and laser diffraction particle size analysis. The synthesized silica exhibited an amorphous structure, with a median particle size (D50) of approximately 88.9 μm. Subsequent annealing at 1200 °C led to crystallization of the silica, resulting in the formation of quartz and cristobalite phases. FTIR analysis revealed characteristic absorption bands associated with Si–O–Si stretching vibrations in the 1000–1100 cm⁻¹ region, as well as bands attributed to hydroxyl groups. The obtained crystalline silica materials demonstrate potential for use as powder materials in thermal spraying technologies.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Rice husk ash can be converted into silica powder that is amorphous after 800 °C treatment and becomes crystalline quartz/cristobalite after annealing at 1200 °C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This creates a low-cost silica feedstock with tunable phase structure for thermal spray powder development and coating applications.
method: Chemically treated rice husk ash to extract SiO2
Heat treated the product at 800 °C for 3 h to form amorphous silica
Annealed at 1200 °C to induce crystallization; characterized by XRD, FTIR, and laser diffraction
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD confirmed amorphous silica after initial processing and identified quartz and cristobalite after 1200 °C annealing, while laser diffraction gave a D50 of about 88.9 μm.
infographic.watch_item: The powder’s relatively large particle size and the phase change at high temperature may affect flowability, deposition behavior, and coating consistency in thermal spray systems.
infographic.paper_title: Synthesis of Amorphous and Crystalline Silicon Dioxide Powder Composites from Rice Husk Ash for Thermal Spray Deposit

zh-Hans.title: 利用稻壳灰合成用于热喷涂沉积的非晶与晶态二氧化硅粉体复合材料
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文通过化学处理并在 800 °C 下热处理 3 h，从稻壳灰中合成了二氧化硅（SiO₂）。采用 X 射线衍射（XRD）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和激光衍射粒度分析研究了所合成二氧化硅的结构与理化性质。所合成的二氧化硅表现为非晶结构，中位粒径（D50）约为 88.9 μm。随后在 1200 °C 退火后，二氧化硅发生结晶，形成石英和方石英相。FTIR 分析表明，在 1000–1100 cm⁻¹ 区域存在与 Si–O–Si 伸缩振动相关的特征吸收带，同时还存在归属于羟基的吸收带。所得晶态二氧化硅材料显示出作为热喷涂技术中粉体材料的应用潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 稻壳灰可转化为二氧化硅粉体，该粉体在 800 °C 处理后为非晶态，在 1200 °C 退火后转变为晶态石英/方石英。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为热喷涂粉体开发和涂层应用提供了一种低成本、相结构可调的二氧化硅原料。
method: 对稻壳灰进行化学处理以提取 SiO2
将产物在 800 °C 下热处理 3 h 以形成非晶二氧化硅
在 1200 °C 下退火以诱导结晶；采用 XRD、FTIR 和激光衍射进行表征
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD 证实初始处理后为非晶二氧化硅，并在 1200 °C 退火后鉴定出石英和方石英；激光衍射测得 D50 约为 88.9 μm。
infographic.watch_item: 该粉体相对较大的粒径以及高温下的相变可能影响其流动性、沉积行为和热喷涂系统中的涂层一致性。
